title: Choose the visual world for The Quvoh
question: The roll assigned Barkada Trip Album. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Barkada Trip Album
options.lineage: instant-film photo walls and group trip albums
options.thesis: The site is the album your group makes after the stay, opened before you go.
options.viewport: The courtyard photo as a large square instant print, slightly tilted, beside 'The whole place is yours.' with Inquire as a marker-circled action.
options.risk: Tips into kid-craft if tilt, tape, and handwriting are sprinkled instead of ruled.

raised.raise: Every photo snaps to a real film format: square photos as instant square, portrait photos as instant mini, so no property photo is ever cropped.
Total ink commitment: paper, one deep green ink, one marker orange. No in-between tints.
Weekday and weekend rates are the same card in home and away colorways, so neither outweighs the other.
Six stay facts each own one fixed frame (two rates, 4 included, +₱250, max 8, 2 p.m. to 12 noon) for a one-glance cross-check.
Amenities packed as one dense ruled packing list instead of nine airy rows.

options.label: Blue Hour Courtyard
options.lineage: the property's own dusk: string bulbs against an indigo sky
options.thesis: Sell the evening you get: the courtyard after sunset, lights on, whole place quiet.
options.viewport: Full-bleed dusk pool photo, headline set in warm light over deep indigo, Inquire lit like a bulb.
options.risk: Familiar dark-hospitality look; daylight interior photos fight the night palette.

options.label: Risograph Zine
options.thesis: Two fluorescent inks misregistered over toothy paper.
options.viewport: Duotone courtyard photo under a misregistered wordmark.
options.risk: Duotone would misrepresent the real property colors.
options.case: Loses clarity: spot inks recolor the real photos; loses audience: art-school register.
options.kept: Total palette commitment, no in-between tints.

options.label: Football Kit Wall
options.thesis: Crest over the heart, colorways that swap.
options.viewport: Logo as crest, weekday and weekend as home and away shirts.
options.risk: Sports costume on a rest-and-swim stay.
options.case: Loses audience and clarity: guests do not read a getaway as a team kit.
options.kept: Home and away colorway logic for the two equal rates.

options.label: Azulejo Hall
options.thesis: Cobalt narrative panels on a tile grid.
options.viewport: Courtyard scene painted across a tile panel.
options.risk: Portuguese tile world has no home in Pampanga.
options.case: Loses both: foreign place, and paintings replace real photos.
options.kept: Everything snaps to whole units: here, real film formats.

options.label: Night Instrument Panel
options.thesis: Six luminous dials, each owning one truth.
options.viewport: Rates and limits as six gauges.
options.risk: Cockpit coldness on a cozy stay.
options.case: Loses both: no guest identifies, gauges obscure plain prices.
options.kept: Six stay facts in six fixed frames, cross-checkable at a glance.

options.label: Japanese Dense Web
options.thesis: Boxed modules packed edge to edge.
options.viewport: Dense module mosaic of facts and photos.
options.risk: Crowds out the photos the owner needs seen.
options.case: Loses both: density fights a slow getaway and a small fact set.
options.kept: Pack the amenity list densely, no whitespace inflation.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The boutique private-stay site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Full-width courtyard photo, name and tagline overlaid, Inquire button, facts row below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other private resort listing by design.
